name: Electron Main Process
description: Electron main process entry. Creates frameless BrowserWindows (1440x900), manages PTY terminal sessions via node-pty, provides IPC handlers for filesystem operations, directory picker, window controls, workspace persistence (last-workspace.txt, recent-workspaces.json, .cockpit/window.json), clipboard, user preferences, shell open, git CLI operations, and spec graph data serving. Multi-window support via single-window-lock topWindow tracking. Path security validation (no symlink escapes).

security.path_traversal: All file I/O validates resolved paths against workspace root. Symbolic link targets within workspace are allowed; outside are rejected.
security.pty_isolation: Each PTY session has isolated cwd. Session IDs are UUIDs. Kill by owner session only.

bridge.preload: contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld exposes all IPC as window.electronAPI via invoke/send wrappers
